content:
rohit_customer: Hey team — we're seeing invalid JSON from the streaming chat endpoint (structured mode). Long responses sometimes end mid-object: final bytes arrive like '... \"choices\": [ ...' and the stream closes before the final ]/}. Happening for ~5% of requests.

anna_support: thanks — can you paste the raw stream output and the exact curl you used? Also which region/account is this on?

rohit_customer: repro command:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat?stream=true&mode=structured" -N
```
raw tail from client:
```
data: {"id":"resp_abc","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"delta":{"content":{"json":{"message":"Hello","items":[{"id":1,"text":"foo"},{"id":2,"text":"bar"}]}}}}]}
data: {"id":"resp_abc","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"delta":{"content":{"json":{"message":"...","items":[{"id":3,"text":"baz"}]}}}}]}
<connection closed by peer>
```
Note missing final closing braces when parsed. Region: us-west-2, request id: req-7788. We are behind Cloudflare + ALB.

anna_support: got it — Cloudflare/ALB noted. Do you also have any client-side timeouts? The last_message_ts on the server side — do you have any proxy logs / tcp events?

rohit_customer: server logs show a TCP FIN around the same time. Client saw socket close. No app exception.

mike_engineer: sounds like a chunk boundary lost when a proxy tears down idle connections. For streaming structured JSON, partial objects are flushed as chunks; if the connection drops mid-object the client gets truncated JSON. Quick options: (1) switch to NDJSON or per-chunk wrapper so each chunk is parseable, (2) use periodic heartbeat frames to keep proxies from closing, (3) increase proxy idle timeouts.

mike_engineer: quick repro tip: run curl with --no-buffer and -v to watch socket close. If you see "+ Fin, ACK" from the server side right after a fragment, it's the proxy doing an early close. Also check ALB idle timeout (default 60s) and Cloudflare edge limits.

mike_engineer: minimal heartbeat SSE you can try from client side to keep connection open:
```

data: {"type":"heartbeat"}

```
Server should flush that every 10s. Ensure Transfer-Encoding: chunked and flush after each chunk.

jess_cs: I'll escalate to infra (P2) and flag eng-runtime. Are you on Dedicated/Private? If Dedicated we can route via your VPC to avoid CF edge.

rohit_customer: we're on hosted but can test a staging Dedicated instance. I added heartbeat every 10s in staging — that fixed the truncation there. Will try prod later.

anna_support: created escalation ticket RED-4532, assigned to eng-runtime. Temporary mitigation: set stream=false for critical consumers or use buffered mode while we investigate.

deploy-bot: Ticket RED-4532 created by jess_cs — assigned to eng-runtime.

rohit_customer: :thumbsup: thanks, will update after prod test.
